aggregation: Accepted per-case metrics, arithmetic mean of available measurements; per-metric counts preserved in CSV/JSON. No output re-parsing.
inclusion: Exactly the five requested models and all 80 matched variants per model/method.

plot_contract.scale_question: How do localization and complete risk retention compare across original SCC sizes for each model?
plot_contract.scale_evidence: Top row localization; bottom row complete endpoint retention. Columns preserve every selected model, bins preserve original scale groups.
plot_contract.coverage_question: What complete risk coverage and compression does each method jointly achieve?
plot_contract.summary: Descriptive means over frozen benchmark variants, not repeated-seed estimates; no inferential error bars or significance tests.
plot_contract.case_unit: 80 variants from 20 source SCCs per model; domain and size aggregates pool the same five models.
plot_contract.reuse: Style-only inheritance from existing manuscript Python figure palette and physical dimensions.
